messages:
elaine: Hey folks — opened PR #842 for the Private Deployments migration guide. I tweaked CLI examples and added a short KMS note. Need 2 reviewers and want to merge before the release window (UTC 23:00) if CI and the preview look good. Netlify preview is 404-ing on static assets though, so not confident to merge yet. :wave:

netlify-bot: build-preview ready: https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.netlify.app/
netlify-bot: status: failed
netlify-bot: error snippet:
```
Build command: npm run docs:build
Error: GET https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.netlify.app/static/css/main.css -> 404
Attempted path: /redwood-docs/static/css/main.css
```

marco: @elaine I'll pick this up. Sounds like a basePath vs absolute URL problem. Check mkdocs.yml `site_url` and any template helpers that prefix assets with a repo path. Also search the repo for lingering `base` replacements used for GH Pages workflows.

samir: :eyes: Two quick guesses: 1) netlify.toml has a `[[redirects]]` or `[[headers]]` rule that rewrites asset paths; 2) your template includes a `{{ repo_base }}` var that used to be set during gh-pages deploys. If you can paste the header template I can grep locally.

elaine: Local build is fine — I ran:
``npm ci && npm run docs:build
# serve static to sanity check
npx http-server site -p 8080
```
Assets served at `/static/css/main.css` with no repo prefix. The preview URL suggests Netlify is expecting a `/redwood-docs` subpath. I may have added a `{{ repo_base }}` while fixing something else. I'll push a patch to revert that and re-run.

docs-bot: link-checker: started on PR #842
docs-bot: Report: 1 broken css link, 2 broken image links

marco: If we need an immediate workaround, we can set `SITE_URL` env var in Netlify preview context to the full preview URL in CI so absolute links resolve. That at least proves the content is good before we figure permanent fix.

samir: I'll take image2 and check the template. Marco, can you handle the css path? I think `use_directory_urls` or `site_url` in mkdocs controls whether assets get prefixed.

tyler: Reminder: release notes reference this migration guide. If docs aren't live with the release, marketing will need to adjust. Can ops approve a docs-only fast-track merge if CI is green?

elaine: I've added [docs-only] to the PR title and listed local repro steps and the Netlify errors in the description. I also put a short note about the KMS flag change in the CLI snippet that needs a careful glance from infra/docs reviewers.

marco: Quick repro steps to simulate Netlify's path handling locally:
1) Serve the site from a subpath: `npx serve -s site --single --port 8080 --base=/redwood-docs`
2) Build with an overridden site_url: `SITE_URL=https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.netlify.app mkdocs build`

samir: I found a small helper in `docs/templates/_includes/head.html` that injects `{{ repo_base }}` before `/static`. That was added years ago for gh-pages; safe to remove for now. Pushing a commit `remove-gh-pages-prefix` to the PR branch.

netlify-bot: re-run deploy-preview triggered by @samir (status: building)

marco: If the re-run still fails, we can commit a netlify-specific `base` override in `netlify.toml` under `[context.deploy-preview.environment] SITE_URL = "https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.netlify.app"` and revert later. That keeps previews green without changing production.

elaine: Thanks all. Assigning reviewers: @marco and @samir. Please prioritize — if both approve and the re-run is green, I'll request the docs-only merge exemption from eng and merge before 23:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: branch protection status: checks pending, required reviewers: 2

docs-bot: link-checker: new status: 1 css 1 image remaining

netlify-bot: deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.netlify.app/ (status: success)

marco: Preview looks good to me. I validated the asset paths and images.

samir: LGTM on content. Left one tiny nit on the KMS paragraph wording (suggest rephrase to avoid implying auto-rotate).

elaine: Thanks both — addressed the nit in a follow-up commit. Requesting fast-track approval from engineering.

tyler: Engineering approves docs-only merges; merge when green.

deploy-bot: merging PR #842 (docs-only)

elaine: Merged and backported a small redirect to avoid stale links. Thanks everyone! :tada:
